tokens.name: scene-100
tokens.usage: Deepest scene color: the solid page ground behind glass, and the fallback when blur is unavailable. Also the ground text is checked against.

tokens.name: scene-200
tokens.usage: Lighter scene stop. The scene is scene-200 fading to scene-100 with two soft glows; it is the only gradient in the system.

tokens.name: scene-glow-blue
tokens.usage: Soft blue light in the top-left of the scene. Scene only; never on components.

tokens.name: scene-glow-warm
tokens.usage: Soft warm light in the bottom-right of the scene (the lamp glow). Scene only.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page ground (same as scene-100). Used for focus-ring gaps and inverse text.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Glass panel: cards, sidebar, tables, alerts, tab bars. Always with blur (blur-md). At 0.78 / 0.72 opacity text stays at 4.5:1 or better over the scene.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Inset tint inside a panel: input fills, inner tiles, skeleton, row hover. No blur.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Nearly opaque glass for what floats: menus, selects, date pickers, dialogs, sheets, toasts, sticky table headers.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline on glass edges and dividers. Not for control outlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines (inputs, selects, checkbox boxes, switch track). 3:1 or better on every panel in both themes. Buttons have no outline.

tokens.name: neutral-fill
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, selected segment, progress track, skeleton, hover on list rows. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: neutral-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of neutral-fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on scene-100, surface-200, surface-300, neutral-fill and surface-overlay.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, placeholders on the same grounds as ink (5.4:1 or better, hover states included).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Spatial blue as a FILL: primary buttons, switch on, checked boxes, selected date, brand mark. Text on it is on-primary. Not for text: use primary-text.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Blue as TEXT or line: links, active nav, selected chip and tab, focus ring, icon accents. 4.7:1 or better on every panel.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for selected rows, active nav item, selected chip, callouts. Pair with primary-text or ink.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (4.6:1 dark, 5.8:1 light).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ember, the warm second hue (the lamp light). One highlight per screen or slide, or the comparison series. Never for warnings or errors. As text: on every panel.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for Ember highlights. Pair with ink or accent text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and fills. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text, icons and fills. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive state: validation text, delete buttons, negative deltas. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: notice icons and help text inside alerts.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind dialogs and sheets (with blur-sm).

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Switch thumb. Always white.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (the story). Blue. 3:1 or better against panels.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (comparison or baseline). Ember. Blue and Ember sit on the blue-orange axis, so they stay distinct for color-blind readers.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. Aqua. Fill and bars only; not for text.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Soft violet. Fill and bars only.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 and 'Other' / unhighlighted bars (the grey bars in the reference).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Slide titles and app hero only. One per screen or slide. Line height 1.2 leaves room for stacked Vietnamese marks (Ể, Ỗ).

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Big numbers on KPI tiles and stat slides. Always with tabular figures.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Báo cáo biến động nhân sự
styles.usage: Page title in webapp and app.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Chi phí lương theo phòng ban
styles.usage: Section headings, card titles on dashboards.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Nội dung chính trên slide và trang đọc dài.
styles.usage: Slide body copy and long-form reading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nhân viên có ngày vào làm sau ngày hiệu lực sẽ không được tính.
styles.usage: Default UI and document text. Minimum body size on mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tabs, table headers.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Dense table cells (laptop only), helper text, metadata.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart axis labels, footnotes, slide source lines. Minimum size anywhere.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Formulas, IDs, code, SQL. For numbers in tables use the sans family with tabular figures instead.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control vertical padding pair, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap inside a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margin on desktop, slide safe margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections, slide title offset.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tags, small badges, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menus, inner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, chart containers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The outer window or hero panel, mobile bottom sheets, slide image frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, toggle tracks, the room switcher bar.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Glass cards and panels at rest. The inset line is the lit top edge of the glass.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, popovers, hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and toasts only.

size.note: Fixed control heights so every button, input and select lines up.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense toolbars and table row actions on laptop only.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height for buttons, inputs, selects, date pickers on laptop.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Mobile app controls and slide-embedded UI. Meets the 44px touch target.

blur.note: Backdrop blur for glass. Applied with saturate(1.5). Removed when the user asks for reduced transparency.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Default glass: cards, sidebar, tables, menus.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Large hero panels and the app window background.
